tools.Name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
tools.Description: An AI-powered tool for generating high-definition short videos from a single theme or keyword, supporting full automation of scripts, visual materials, subtitles, and music.

tools.Name: MarkItDown
tools.Description: A lightweight Python utility by Microsoft for converting various file types (PDF, Office, Images, Audio, HTML) into Markdown, optimized for LLM consumption.
tools.Use_Case: Preparing documents, presentations, and multimedia transcripts for AI text analysis and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.

tools.Name: Scrapling
tools.Description: An adaptive Web Scraping framework designed for modern web environments, featuring intelligent element tracking, anti-bot bypass, and a full crawling framework.
tools.Use_Case: Scalable, resilient web data extraction that automatically adapts to website layout changes.
